C29.title_zh: 身体、生态参与与认知选择
C29.title_en: Embodied organization, ecological participation and cognitive choice
C29.claim_zh: 细胞、器官与身体通过实际组织和支持相连；认知在其中形成分辨、保持和选择，活动又改变身体及生态条件。生态参与不等同于固定解剖层级。
C29.claim_en: Cells, organs and bodies are related through actual organization and support; cognition discriminates, retains and selects within these relations, and activity changes bodily and ecological conditions. Ecological participation differs from a fixed anatomical hierarchy.
C29.scope_zh: 解释性整合；四项原始研究支持分别的机制连接，另有14项新 Lean 定理；不冒称单一完整生物轨迹、意识理论或普遍伦理证明
C29.scope_en: Explanatory integration; four primary studies constrain separate mechanisms, with 14 additional Lean theorems; no single complete biological trajectory, theory of consciousness or universal ethical proof

F21.title_zh: 选择影响尺度误差的形式检查
F21.title_en: Formal checks of action-sensitive scale errors
F21.claim_zh: 所选行动影响之差进入有限时域误差界；阈值余量足以保持指定选择，近阈值反例及共享支持被他者消耗后的计划失败均经过实查。
F21.claim_en: Differences in selected action effects enter the finite-horizon error bound; threshold margins suffice to preserve specified choices, with checked near-threshold counterexamples and failed retained plans after another participant consumes shared support.
F21.scope_zh: 14项新定理／63项继承审计，使用标准逻辑；策略、对应和活动规则明示，有限见证无生理拟合或生态更新
F21.scope_en: 14 new theorems / 63 inherited audits, with standard logic; policies, correspondence and activity laws explicit; finite witness has no physiological fit or ecological renewal

C29.title_zh: 身体、生态参与与认知选择
C29.title_en: Embodied organization, ecological participation and cognitive choice
C29.claim_zh: 细胞、器官与身体通过实际组织和支持相连；认知在其中形成分辨、保持和选择，活动又改变身体及生态条件。生态参与不等同于固定解剖层级。
C29.claim_en: Cells, organs and bodies are related through actual organization and support; cognition discriminates, retains and selects within these relations, and activity changes bodily and ecological conditions. Ecological participation differs from a fixed anatomical hierarchy.
C29.scope_zh: 解释性整合保留；继原14项定理后，新增26项 Lean 定理接通明确模型中的组织传递、保持、支持及接触改变。403项发表测量重分析通过；完整生物—学习—生态闭环的定量对应尚未完成。
C29.scope_en: Earlier explanatory integration retained; after the 14-result extension, 26 new Lean theorems connect organized transmission, retention, support and contact in an explicit model. Reanalysis checks 403 published measurements; quantitative correspondence for the complete biological–learning–ecological loop remains unfinished.

links.label_zh: 生物对应与实测重分析

F21.title_zh: 组织、选择与尺度对应的形式检查
F21.title_en: Formal checks of organization, choice and scale correspondence
F21.claim_zh: 所选行动影响之差进入有限时域误差界；阈值余量足以保持指定选择，近阈值反例及共享支持被他者消耗后的计划失败均经过实查。 新构造证明实际描述组合、保持历史与区域差异的必要性，并接通有支持的选择与后续接触。
F21.claim_en: Differences in selected action effects enter the finite-horizon error bound; threshold margins suffice to preserve specified choices, with checked near-threshold counterexamples and failed retained plans after another participant consumes shared support. The new construction proves actual view composition and the consequential role of retained history and regional differences, connecting supported selection to subsequent contact.
F21.scope_zh: 旧14项定理／63项继承审计保留；新26项定理／77项继承审计分别计录。标准逻辑，无自定义公理。规律、路线、保持、费用、时序与对应明确给定；没有生理拟合或生态再生证明。
F21.scope_en: Earlier 14 theorems / 63 inherited audits retained; new 26 theorems / 77 inherited audits recorded separately. Standard logic, no custom axioms. Laws, routes, retention, costs, schedules and correspondence are explicit; no physiological fit or ecological-renewal proof.
